lineItems.explanation: Quoted for 2 days in Twin Sharing @ ₹9,000/day. Patient was discharged late on Day 3 due to mild post-op nausea, triggering a full 3rd day room charge.
lineItems.flagText: Late discharge triggered 1 extra full day room charge

lineItems.explanation: Primary surgeon & specialist anesthetist charges matched initial written estimate exactly.
Quoted basic laparoscopic tower fee. Billed ₹4,500 extra for 'Harmonic Scalpel Disposable Blade' which was not specified in the pre-admission quote.
lineItems.flagText: Unlisted Harmonic energy blade fee added

lineItems.explanation: Extra postoperative Electrolyte (Na+/K+) panel and emergency repeat Hemoglobin ordered due to mild BP fluctuation.
Estimated ₹14,000. Billed ₹24,300. Markups found on surgical drapes, IV cannulas, and surgical gloves billed at hospital institutional MRP (65% variance).
lineItems.flagText: High consumable markup — contestable with billing desk

lineItems.explanation: Billed: ₹2,500 Biomedical Waste Disposal, ₹2,000 Hospital Registration/Admin fee, and ₹3,000 Medical Records & Sanitization. None were disclosed on the initial quotation.
lineItems.flagText: Hidden surcharge not disclosed prior to admission

negotiationTips: Ask the hospital billing desk to waive the ₹7,500 unlisted administrative & biomedical waste charges, as they were not disclosed in the pre-authorization estimate.
Inquire why the 3rd day room rent was billed as a full 24-hour rate rather than a half-day checkout rate.
Request an itemized pharmacy bill to check if consumables were billed above retail MRP.

lineItems.explanation: Capped strictly under NPPA (National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority) government ceiling price.
Additional ₹3,000 billed for femoral compression closure device.
Patient kept in Cardiac ICU for 32 hours instead of estimated 24 hours for extended rhythm monitoring.
lineItems.flagText: 8 extra hours CCU stay billed as 2nd full day

lineItems.explanation: Cross-consultation added: Nephrologist called to review borderline Creatinine (1.4 mg/dL) following contrast dye injection.
High-dose IV Glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitor (Tirofiban) and disposable guide catheter packs billed above baseline estimate.
Sterilization kit, medical record processing, and documentation fees.

negotiationTips: Submit the Nephrologist cross-consultation report to insurance to claim the additional ₹6,000 under medically necessary complications.
Check if your policy covers the vascular closure device under surgical consumables.

procedure: Inpatient Medical Management (Dengue Fever with Thrombocytopenia)

lineItems.explanation: Stay extended by 1 day because platelet count was still recovering (45,000 cells/uL on Day 3).
Serial CBC performed every 12 hours (6 times total) to monitor rapid platelet fluctuation, plus Dengue NS1 & Liver profile.
Continuous IV crystalloids, antiemetics, paracetamol infusions, and supportive electrolytes.
Specialized barrier nursing and vector-borne isolation protocol fees added.
lineItems.flagText: Vector isolation fee not in pre-estimate

negotiationTips: Insurance often deductions serial CBCs as redundant; have the treating physician certify that 12-hourly tests were critical to monitor shock syndrome.
Ensure the hospital provides pharmacy bills with batch numbers and tax invoices for complete reimbursement.
